versions.changelog:
- Marked skill as internal via metadata update.
- Removed the public skill-card.md file.

- Initial release of ultra-fast speech transcription using iFLYTEK Speed Transcription API.
- Supports transcription of audio files (MP3, WAV, PCM) up to 5 hours long in ~20 seconds per hour.
- Automatic language and Chinese dialect detection (202+ dialects), plus English support.
- Includes options for domain-specific optimization, speaker separation, and subtitle output.
- Detailed setup instructions, common use cases, error handling, and FAQ provided.
